_comment: Dev emulator profile. Simulates two chained Adafruit 64x64 HUB75 panels at 3mm pitch (P3) as a single 128x64 canvas. The 'real' pixel style plus glow approximates individually-lit LEDs so on-screen previews match the physical sign. Panel geometry (rows/cols/chain/parallel) lives in config.yaml under `matrix:`; this file only controls how the emulator *looks*.

browser._comment: Browser adapter serves a live preview at http://localhost:<port>.
